Topics covered in this PDF

BSOE-142 (Indian Sociological Traditions) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • D.P. Mukerji and A.R. Desai, Benoy Kumar Sarkar, Sanskritization and Westernization, feminist sociologists, nationalism in India
  • The Indological approach, the Bombay School of Sociology, G.S. Ghurye on tribes, sociology of Indian sociology, caste and kinship

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment, total marks 100, three sections, answer all questions. Section I: two descriptive questions in about 500 words (2 x 20 = 40). Section II: three middle category questions in about 250 words (3 x 10 = 30). Section III: five short category questions in about 100 words (5 x 6 = 30)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

How to use the solved PDF properly

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • First read your official assignment paper and choose the questions you must answer
  • Learn the answer structure from the PDF: introduction, concept or facts, examples and conclusion
  • Write your final answer in your own words. The university alone evaluates it
